title: Prisma 5.22 $use middleware is the GUC path and blocks a Prisma 6/7 upgrade
blast: lib/db/prisma.ts installs client.$use for RLS GUCs. Prisma 5.15+ deprecates $use; Prisma 6 removes it. Any WAP_RLS_GUC_ENABLED=true flip plus a client bump ships a compile/runtime break on every Prisma query. transactionOptions + flatten-tx override also sit on this client.
evidence: package.json:@prisma/client and prisma pinned 5.22.0. lib/db/prisma.ts:138 client.$use(async (params, next) => { ... }). lib/db/prisma.ts:106-108 GUC layer off unless WAP_RLS_GUC_ENABLED=true. Prisma 6 release notes: $use removed in favor of $extends.

title: @heroicons/react is a production dependency used only by the Astryx lab
blast: The package ships in the production install and is a second icon family next to lucide-react (hundreds of portal imports) plus self-hosted Material Symbols. Unused prod deps inflate install + confuse bundle budgets.
evidence: package.json:59 @heroicons/react ^2.2.0 under dependencies (not devDependencies). rg "from '@heroicons" -g '*.ts' -g '*.tsx' hits only app/dev/astryx/*. lucide-react is imported across app/admin, app/(portal), components/portal.

title: Vercel production build runs a nested marketing npm ci before Next build
blast: vercel.json buildCommand always cd marketing && npm ci && npm run build && cp dist into public/ before Next. Two lockfiles (pnpm root + npm marketing). Cold prod builds pay a full Astro install on every production deploy; ignoreCommand forces production to always build. A marketing dep break blocks the Next app deploy.
evidence: vercel.json:2-3 buildCommand and ignoreCommand. vercel.json:3 production ignore always exit 1 (never skip). package.json:7 root build is Next-only and does not copy marketing/dist — self-host and local npm run build omit the Astro tree.
verify: rg -n 'marketing && npm ci' vercel.json && rg -n '"build":' package.json
